verdict.rationale: Vendor docs state that Procedures train Fin to handle queries with multiple steps, business logic and third-party systems from start to finish, and that Fin handles multi-step queries end to end. Guidance and Procedures help articles exist, which supports the multi-step troubleshooting half of the story. Nothing in the pack explicitly shows Fin asking clarifying questions, and all support is vendor marketing without hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of clarifying-question behavior, detailed documentation of troubleshooting flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
